config.weighting: match-weighted paired losses; resampled day totals/counts
config.scope: Exploratory sensitivity of already frozen historical predictions; no statistical model superiority claim.

results.block_unit: Ordered observed UTC match-days, not elapsed calendar days
results.difference_direction: candidate minus reference; lower is better
limits: Fixed previously fitted forecasts and paired historical labels; no refitting or selection uncertainty.
Stationary resampling assumes weak dependence across ordered observed days, wraps at the end and does not preserve calendar gaps or season breaks.
HAC uses match-weighted day-total ratio influences with Bartlett lag weights; it is a local grouped adaptation, not the original equally spaced DM test.
Lag and block grids are sensitivity settings, not estimated optimal values. Percentiles are pointwise descriptive ranges, not validated or simultaneous confidence coverage.
No p-values, rejection labels, model reselection or prospective superiority claims. Repeated historical evaluation and long-range team dependence remain limitations.
results.probability_normalization: Original rows retained within existing evaluator tolerance1e-6
results.weighting: Pooled matches in each resampled set of days; unequal daily counts retained

independent_replay.method: Scalar per-match loss formulas; dense Bartlett covariance matrices; independently replay restart/circular draws then expand whole days back to actual matches before averaging.

limits: Historical snapshots reused across earlier studies; reference and displayed configurations chosen after earlier results. Exploratory and conditional, no p-values or multiple-comparison significance claim.

Observed UTC match-days preserve contemporaneous matches, not equal calendar spacing. Circular bootstrap can cross the end of this historical cohort; seasonal breaks and long-range repeated-team dependence are not modeled.

Pointwise percentile ranges and grouped Bartlett standard errors are descriptive sensitivity diagnostics; no coverage validation, fixed-b critical values, original DM test or full ForeComp reproduction.
Training, tuning, selection and parameter uncertainty are conditioned away; no frozen predictions, production bundle or database record changed.

provenance_enrichment.reason: Include reused probability-validator dependency app/ml/model.py in code receipts. Its hash matches the incoming manifest and remained unchanged during execution.
